claims.observation: Rare small standalone cells show breakdown followed by low-resistance near-linear LRS and sharp transitions; most small standalone cells fluctuate without stable RS.
claims.interpretation_limit: Filament assignment partly uses electrical signatures. Paper example values do not replace raw-workbook gates without source mapping.

claims.observation: VG1.1 cells exhibit high resistances, nonlinear currents, progressive transitions and first-sweep activation.
claims.short_quote: we cannot claim that the RS is filamentary
claims.interpretation_limit: Do not describe both topologies as experimentally established continuous-metal-filament devices.

claims.observation: VG1.5 cell has high cycle variability with near-linear and nonlinear LRS classes.
claims.interpretation_limit: Stochastic filament/nonfilament switching is the authors interpretation, not atom-resolved dynamics or species identification.

claims.observation: Small stressed cells show partial degradation/discontinuous particles; larger cells show conical paths. Metal migration not detected in small-cell EELS/EDX.
claims.interpretation_limit: Nondetection does not exclude low-abundance or transient ionic motion; postmortem images do not measure growth/rupture trajectories.

claims.observation: Transistor controls current; authors attribute improved soft switching to reduced overshoot and parasitic transient.
claims.interpretation_limit: Reviewed target sections do not show a matched simultaneous high-bandwidth bare/series overshoot comparison or establish these as calibrated values for local workbook runs.

claims.observation: No-hBN controls do not switch; Au/Ag cells without Ti switch; O-rich Ti detected.
claims.interpretation_limit: Interface ionic exchange is proposed; neither active ion species nor exclusive Ti-oxide switching is established. Controls oppose a model where Ti oxide alone produces all RS.

claims.observation: Resistance states/window vary with pulse duration and write/erase amplitude.
claims.interpretation_limit: Endpoint dose dependence alone does not separate heating, charge exchange and structural kinetics; pulse times do not identify unknown DC scan timing.
Do not pool electrode-specific times into a common target parameter; time asymmetry is not local thermometry or ion identification.

claims.observation: RESET end voltage programs multiple levels;0.1V read retention measured up to7h for several states with under5percent drift; other states checked up to200s.
claims.interpretation_limit: Constrains fast spontaneous recovery hypotheses; does not prove infinite retention.

claims.observation: No local-temperature trace, temperature-sweep activation energy, or field-vs-heating separation identified in the reviewed target material.
claims.interpretation_limit: This is bounded to the inspected material, not a universal assertion that no thermal evidence exists elsewhere.

claims.observation: Multilevel RTN, occasional reset soft errors, recovery in later cycles.
claims.interpretation_limit: Supports considering stochastic events/history; does not identify target species or calibrate target rates.

claims.observation: Low-current CAFM LRS loses retention around10-100s; author proposes B-ion back diffusion and discusses possible AFM drift.
claims.interpretation_limit: B-negative-ion identity and timescale cannot be imported into Au-Ti/hBN/W; target Nature retention differs.

claims.observation: Calculated defect charge changes configuration energies/barriers and electronic structure/interlayer connectivity.
claims.interpretation_limit: A possible charge-structure coupling mechanism, not target microscopy or chemical identification.

claims.observation: Authors estimate short relaxation for some computed low barriers and discuss larger barriers for long retention.
claims.interpretation_limit: Do not transplant approximately0.3eV barriers as parameters for the Nature hours-stable states.

candidates.physical_content: Nonlinear defect network plus stress-activated reversible near-ohmic connectivity; a in siemens, no identified metallic species.
helps: Bare LRS no longer requires soft u to reach the old single-branch broad-Gamma read bound.
Two independent retained states make old scalar-cycle theorem inapplicable without proving success.
does_not_automatically_help: Original series beta1 budget conflict persists if a is negligible and soft dynamics unchanged.
RESET tail requires a to switch off enough; fixed leakage cannot be hidden.
falsifiable_predictions: Frozen-state increase of a produces an approximately ohmic incremental current; dlnI/dlnV tends1 as a dominates.
At approximately fixed u, DeltaI/V is voltage-independent whereas a multiplicative change predicts I2/I1 voltage-independent.
Stress protocols should activate a continuously, and RESET should erase it enough to obey each same-cycle tail limit.
restrictions: No topology/VG/cycle index in the material branch selector.
Nonlinear terminal series curve is not proof of nonlinear material current; de-embed T.
A changed u can also alter shape in multiplicative models; shape test requires controlled read states.
Old total-current Ron envelope does not transfer unchanged to soft-branch Ron after adding aV.
Predeclare whether each state is driven by total current, branch carrier flux, or local power and how branches couple; do not switch the driving-current definition post hoc for fit quality.

candidates.physical_content: Finite source compliance response and parasitic node charge acting on common material law; thermal state only if constrained.
helps: Potentially different local stress histories and growth severity between topologies despite common material law.
does_not_automatically_help: Quasistatically eliminated parasitics do not constitute a new retained degree of freedom.
No measured local run clock or overshoot trace is created by adopting reported setup values.
falsifiable_predictions: At same steady compliance, independently changing capacitance or front duration should change measured overshoot dose and resulting state.
Matching actual local voltage/current waveforms should remove circuit-only topology differences.

candidates.physical_content: Coupled retained structure and interface charge/occupancy, without assigning unmeasured ionic species.
helps: Independent electrochemical state can encode polarity/prehistory and alter activation/self-limitation.
does_not_automatically_help: Instantaneous equilibrium occupancy collapses back to a single state.
Computed graphene/trivacancy barriers do not identify target kinetic parameters.
falsifiable_predictions: After matched non-disturbing read curves, opposite-polarity subthreshold conditioning should produce reproducible waiting-dependent rectification or switching differences.
Any postulated relaxation must coexist with measured hours-scale stability.

shared_equation_requirement: One material F and state law for1R/1T1M; topology changes circuit boundary only. a may arise/disappear only from actual stress/history, never explicit topology or cycle labels.
thermal_status: Candidate rate modifier, not separately established mechanism: target local T/tau_th not identified.
stochastic_status: If used, finite-event kinetics must predict distributions/dwell statistics; arbitrary added noise or deterministic scalar averaging is not a mechanism or automatic escape from scalar constraints.
prior_conclusions_policy: No previous outputs or conclusions changed. New aV branch changes premises of old single-branch bounds; it does not falsify those conditional audits or validate a unified solution.
data_scope: No new native observation arrays, holdout, ODE, fit or simulations accessed/run. Existing published experimental values are kept distinct from workbook gate/calibration values.
